description: Returns the guarantors, named parties and contacts that SEC filings give for one loan (prospectus Annex A-1 and the trust's 10-D), each with a link to its filing. Use it after get_loan when asked who stands behind a loan. Without a key it returns only how many are on file.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

name: get_loan_parties

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation getLoanParties). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: Date of the cmbs.news loan data this answer was built from, YYYY-MM-DD (the loan record's as-of date), not the date of the prospectus.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

contacts.description: The named parties and contacts of each trust holding the loan, exactly as printed on the trust's latest monthly 10-D distribution statement (so current as of that filing, not issuance).

address.description: Mailing address as printed, its lines separated by ' | '; null when none.

email.description: The email text exactly as printed (can hold several addresses joined by ';' or 'and'); null when none is printed or the printed text is not made of whole addresses.

emails.description: The same addresses as a list, one address each.

person.description: Contact person as printed (can name more than one person); null when the statement names only the company.

role.description: The party's role as printed on the statement (free text). Values: Contact named on the statement = label added by cmbs.news for the one named contact a Citibank statement prints with no role beside it; (any other text) = the role exactly as the statement prints it.

scope.description: What the contact is to this loan. Values: loan = the printed role names this loan specifically (e.g. a loan-specific special servicer or directing holder); trust = a general party of the trust; a loan split across trusts or with its own servicing agreement may be serviced elsewhere.

source.description: The SEC filing this contact was was read from.

trust.description: Name of the trust whose statement lists this contact.

flags.description: Three yes/no facts the prospectus prints about the borrower structure, from the same prospectus row as purpose.

delawareStatutoryTrust.description: Whether the borrower is a Delaware statutory trust, as printed.

opportunityZone.description: Whether the property is in a qualified opportunity zone, as printed.

tenantsInCommon.description: Whether the borrowers hold the property as tenants in common, as printed.

freeUnlock.description: true when a signed-in free account gets the full paid answer for the one loan it chose to unlock; absent otherwise.

guarantors.description: Guarantor and sponsor names the loan's prospectuses print in Annex A-1, one line per distinct name and role, as of issuance (they do not update if the loan or borrower changes hands).

alsoIn.description: The loan's other notes whose prospectuses print the same name and role.

asset.description: That note's asset number in the trust's SEC loan file (a string).

guarantorConflict.description: A sentence quoted from a prospectus that contradicts the guarantor column: it says the loan has no (separate) guarantor, or limits the guaranty.

guarantorConflictPartial.description: true when the quoted sentence only limits the guaranty (for example recourse is excluded for some matters); false when it flatly says there is no guarantor, and false when there is no conflict.

guarantorConflictSource.description: The prospectus the quoted sentence comes from (it can be another trust's prospectus for the same loan).

name.description: The name exactly as the prospectus cell prints it, footnote marks removed.

role.description: The prospectus's own column heading the name was printed under (free text, e.g.

source.description: The prospectus this name was read from.

trust.description: Name of the trust whose prospectus prints this line (the first of the loan's notes that does).

hasData.description: true when at least one guarantor/sponsor line or one contact row is on file for the loan; false when both lists are empty.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

limits.description: Link to the page describing limits and plans.

message.description: Plain sentence saying what is not included in this plan and where limits and plans are described.

newCash.description: The principal's (sponsor's) new cash contribution at closing, from the prospectus's 'new cash' column, as a display string in whole dollars with a dollar sign and commas ("$2,309,102"; "$0" when zero...

newCashSource.description: The prospectus the new cash figure was read from; null when newCash is null.

filed.description: Date the filing was made with the SEC, YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: Name of the form and the part of it that was read.

url.description: Link to the filed document on sec.gov (EDGAR).

onFile.description: Free plan: counts of what a paid plan would return for this loan; never a name, phone or email.

contacts.description: Count of contact rows on file from the trusts' latest 10-D statements, after the same filtering a paid answer applies.

guarantors.description: Count of distinct guarantor and sponsor lines on file for the loan (a name counts once per role; the same text printed as both guarantor and sponsor is one line).

hasGuarantorColumn.description: true when at least one of the loan's prospectus rows prints a name in the guarantor column; false when only a sponsor is printed, or nothing is on file.

roles.description: The kinds of names on file, without the names.

sources.description: Which filings the counts came from.

trusts.description: Count of distinct trusts those contact rows come from.

plan.description: The caller's plan; always "free" in this answer.

proRequired.description: Always true in this answer: the data needs a paid plan (Pro or Team).

purpose.description: Loan purpose as the prospectus prints it (free text).

purposeSource.description: The prospectus the purpose and flags were read from.

filed.description: Date the filing was made with the SEC, YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: Name of the form and the part of it that was read.

url.description: Link to the filed document on sec.gov (EDGAR).

slug.description: The loan's identifier on cmbs.news (last part of its page URL).

source.description: Fixed attribution line: SEC EDGAR Form ABS-EE and Form 10-D filings, read by cmbs.news; servicer-reported, unaudited; link to the terms.

url.description: Link to the loan's page on cmbs.news.

title: Guarantors and contacts for a loan
